CSCO.rationale: Cisco shows solid fundamental health with accelerating revenue and EPS growth (Q2 FY26 revenue +9.7% YoY, EPS +31.1% YoY), strong gross margins (~65%), and a healthy balance sheet (debt-to-equity 0.52). The recurring revenue shift and AI networking opportunity provide a credible growth narrative. However, valuation has expanded dramatically — P/E has risen from ~28x a year ago to ~41x currently, near the top of its 365-day range (27-47x), while P/B has nearly doubled from ~5.9x to ~9.5x. This valuation expansion significantly exceeds the fundamental improvement, making the stock expensive vs its own history. The upcoming Q4 FY26 earnings report (analysts expect EPS of $0.99, +22% YoY) and raised AI order guidance ($9B) provide a near-term catalyst, but the stock's +27% quarterly price move already prices in much of this optimism. Net: good business trajectory but stretched valuation limits upside.
